story.iWant: to create, view, update, and retire households with accurate occupant context
story.soThat: the community structure remains organized and supports downstream resident and service workflows

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Households list page shows each household's name, type, occupant count, and construction date.
“Add Household” form captures household name, type, construction date, bedrooms, bathrooms, and room/unit numbers.
Successful save creates the household record in Appwrite.
Household detail view displays metadata, lists occupants (initially empty), and prompts administrators to add residents.
Edit and delete flows confirm actions and respect RBAC visibility requirements.
Dashboard widget summarizes total households grouped by type.
Deletion is blocked when the household still has occupants assigned.

docs.doc: Outlines required households list, creation form, detail view messaging, dashboard widget, and occupant-safe deletion rules for this story. [docs/epics.md#146-159]
Specifies household data fields (types, rooms, construction details) and links to residents/guests for full occupancy visibility. [docs/PRD.md#101-109]
Describes normalized Appwrite schema with households tables and resident foreign keys, plus indexed queries for occupant lookups. [docs/architecture.md#854-899]
Details Dexie-based offline queue, sync notifications, and connectivity handling that households CRUD must integrate with. [docs/architecture.md#324-556]
Defines Households list/add/detail flows within the core navigation, including role-based module visibility and responsive patterns. [docs/ux-specification.md#132-275]
Captures RBAC utilities, dashboard widget scaffolding, and navigation patterns to reuse for households experiences. [docs/stories/story-1.5.md#56-147]
Provides manual verification plan for permission-based navigation and visibility checks used by households pages. [docs/testing.md#220-255]

Existing dashboard widget displays households totals, illustrating data contracts to extend with real metrics. [docs/stories/story-1.5.md#126-147]
Provides interim households statistics used by dashboard widgets until real Appwrite data is wired. [docs/stories/story-1.5.md#126-147]
Fetches user roles and exposes session state consumed by permissions and households route access checks. [docs/stories/story-1.4.md#286-305]

node.package: UI framework providing layout, drawer, form, and dialog components used across households flows.
Composition API base for pages, composables, and stores.
State management for households data stores and auth context.
Routing metadata and guards controlling module access.
Backend SDK for households CRUD operations and indexing.
IndexedDB wrapper powering offline queue for household mutations.
Utility for formatting construction dates and timeline values.
Supports future visualization of household trends within dashboard widgets.

constraints.constraint: All Vue components must use `` syntax and follow Quasar component conventions. [docs/architecture.md#293-321]
Persist households and resident links using normalized Appwrite tables with indexed foreign keys to enable occupant queries. [docs/architecture.md#854-899]
Reuse RBAC utilities (`usePermissions`, router guards) for visibility and action permissions; do not duplicate permission logic. [docs/stories/story-1.5.md#56-137]
Integrate with offline sync notifications so users are warned when actions queue offline and sync resumes. [docs/architecture.md#324-556]
Document manual verification outcomes per MVP testing strategy; automated suites remain deferred. [docs/testing.md#220-255]

tests.standards: Manual verification remains the standard for MVP: follow documented RBAC navigation checks and households UX walkthroughs, capturing results for each acceptance criterion. [docs/testing.md#220-255]
tests.locations: Manual verification notes recorded in story Dev Notes; future automated suites will live under src/tests/ when enabled.

ideas.idea: Verify households list fetch shows name, type, occupant count, and construction date while respecting permissions.
Exercise the create and edit form, validating required fields and error messaging when data is missing.
Confirm Appwrite tables receive persisted household records and offline queue synchronizes queued writes.
Open a household detail view, ensure occupant panel displays prompt when empty, and verify occupant list updates after linking residents.
Trigger edit/delete actions to ensure confirmation dialogs appear and permission checks prevent unauthorized access.
Load dashboard widget and confirm totals by type match underlying data set once households exist.
Attempt to delete a household with occupants and confirm guard prevents deletion with clear messaging.
